environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed as a Knative serving revision on GKE Autopilot with a pod-level RuntimeDefault+ custom seccomp profile applied via the node's /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/notify-strict.json. The profile inherits from RuntimeDefault but adds explicit SCMP_ACT_ERRNO returns for connect(2) and sendto(2) syscalls when the destination port argument (in sockaddr_in.sin_port network byte order) does not match the pre-approved egress port 443. The profile also blocks raw socket creation (socket with SOCK_RAW). Additionally, a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy with spec.egress limited to port 443 TCP to the mesh gateway CIDR 10.96.0.0/16 is applied to the pod's namespace. The SMTP relay is only reachable on port 587 via a service mesh VirtualService that requires mTLS origination with a cert issued by the cluster's internal CA — but the pod's service account lacks the secretRef binding to the TLS secret 'smtp-client-cert' in the namespace, so Envoy sidecar will reject the upstream connection with a 503.
